## `srs`

```text
Semantic Record System CLI

Usage: srs [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  note           Note management commands
  instance       Read any instance (Note or Record) without knowing its tier
  schema         JSON Schema generation (RFC-035)
  repo           Repository inspection commands
  migrate        Migration handoff commands
  tag            Tag definition management commands
  relation-type  Relation type definition commands
  field          Field definition commands
  type           Type definition commands
  record         Generic record commands
  relation       Relation commands
  protocol       Protocol definition commands
  blueprint      Blueprint definition commands
  container      Container grouping and membership commands
  render         Render document outputs from Compositions
  package        Package management commands
  theme          Theme definition management
  view           View (L1 field view) definition management
  composition    Composition (L2 render view) definition management
  vocabulary     Vocabulary definition commands (RFC-006)
  lifecycle      Lifecycle definition commands (RFC-006)
  term           Term definition commands (RFC-006)
  mcp            Model Context Protocol server (stdio)
  tree           Show the hierarchical record tree rooted at top-level or specified instances
  find           Discover instances by structured filters + content search (ext:discovery)
  registry       Registry catalog commands (ext:registry)
  context        Addressability context-query commands (ext:addressability)
  attachment     Source document attachment commands
  archive        Archive pack/unpack commands (.srs SRSzip format, ADR-036)
  slice          RFC-026 container slices: one container as a standalone .srs (ADR-051)
  help           Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - json: JSON output (default)
          - yaml: YAML output
          - text: Human-readable text output (planned, currently returns diagnostic)
          
          [default: json]

      --store <STORE>
          Storage backend override. By default the backend is inferred from the repository location
          
          [possible values: file, json]

      --pretty
          Pretty-print JSON output (no effect on text format)

      --container <CONTAINER_ID>
          Container scope: constrains list/create/delete to this container's membership; on `context record` it adds the record's arrangement subtree in this container

      --actor <ACTOR>
          Session actor for everything this invocation creates (RFC-046 `createdBy`): JSON `{"kind":"human|ai","id":"<non-empty>","name":"<optional>"}`. Defaults to the `SRS_ACTOR` environment variable; with neither, creations are unattributed. Host configuration only — a request payload never carries it. An invalid value refuses every creating command (`actor-invalid`); a corpus below dataModelRevision 9 refuses an actor session (`revision-too-old`) until `repo apply-migration --id rfc046-actor-provenance`. A `.srsj` migrated in memory on open refuses every write first (`migration-required-before-write`) until its migrations are applied

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
```
